tasks.short: Teach contact-lens insertion, removal and care

steps.what: Show contact-lens insertion, removal and cleaning and observe customer practice
Enter observed handling competence and care advice in the optical record

tasks.design: Keep demonstration and supervised customer practice human, with a separate original instruction entry in the optical-practice record category {OTHER}. Test the existing native care-instruction form; it does not remove recording the customer's observed competence, and its normal save earns no saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Safe handling must be demonstrated by the customer, not merely described.
tasks.enabler_now: No new software change replaces observed practice or the actual competence entry.
tasks.still_hard: Hygiene, anxiety, dexterity and recognising when independent handling is unsafe.
tasks.human_edge: Watch technique and correct it sensitively.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: contact-lens instruction requires observed customer practice and an accurate original account of handling competence.

assumptions: Boundary is the fitting-related instruction session and its existing optical care record used at follow-up. Validate that actual record and these provisional shares.

The optician observes competence in s1 and enters it in s2. Manufacturer-approved care instructions are already supplied with the lens; no extra instruction lookup, transcript or new record is assumed.
The native form is already available. Personal observations and advice still require entry; ordinary author saving is retained and ungated. No separate handout send or new care log is invented.
No proposed change means zero incremental upkeep.
unknowns: Actual instruction-record fields and entry time
Whether a separate personalised written instruction is normally supplied
research_questions: Does the current native form leave any real repeated wording beyond the observations that must be entered?

already_counted.description: Demonstration, customer practice and original record entry remain in full.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: All 100 focal hours remain after splitting the actual instruction record from customer practice. Neither an already supplied care leaflet nor the ordinary record save removes established labour.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Check prescription and capture frame, lens and fitting measurements
Prepare grinding and fabrication instructions in the laboratory work-order form
Check final lens instructions, measurements, units and destination laboratory
outputs: final checked laboratory work order and destination

steps.what: Release the checked work order to the optical laboratory
inputs: final checked laboratory work order and destination

tasks.design: Configure native lens-order fields in the optical-practice category {OTHER} to reuse checked prescription, frame and fitting values in a draft laboratory order. The optician still chooses lens options, resolves exceptions, checks every instruction and releases the exact completed order separately.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manually repeating prescription and fitting values introduces typing work and error risk.
tasks.enabler_now: Native work-order templates can reuse fields already captured and checked.
tasks.still_hard: Prescription interpretation, lens/frame compatibility and unusual fabrication instructions.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise implausible measurements and unsuitable lens choices.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated work-order typing; unchanged dispensing accountability.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: optical work-order forms can reuse checked prescription and fitting values while retaining human lens selection and laboratory release.

assumptions: Boundary includes preparation and the actual lab handoff of an order within the optician's existing authority. Shares are provisional, not measured.

The examining practitioner supplies right/left sphere, cylinder, axis, addition and prism where relevant; the optician obtains frame identifier, lens choice, pupillary distance, fitting height and units and captures/checks them in s1. The measurement act may originate in the separate fitting task; this task counts its verification and original work-order input entry, not a second measurement saving.

The laboratory maintains product codes and permitted options. Test native work-order reuse first. Only repeated prescription/frame/fitting field typing, 30% of s2, is removed; custom instructions and wrong/missing field repair remain in s2-s3. No free OCR or inferred prescription.

s3 checks the complete order, quantities, commercial terms where applicable and exact lab destination before s4; edits void approval. Ordinary draft saving remains fully retained without a self-gate; actual lab release has only its real 1% share, with no saving.
unknowns: Actual reusable fields and current native template
Whether additional purchase approval is required
research_questions: Can native reuse reproduce a checked lens order including laterality, units and special instructions?

already_counted.description: Source capture, custom instruction entry, mismatch repair and final verification remain.

incremental.description: Optician validates order fields after laboratory catalogue changes.

approvals.approved_version: s3 final complete laboratory order, lens and fitting values, terms and exact lab destination; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100; 40*0.30=12 repeated-entry hours removed less 1 upkeep gives 11 net. Cautious case: a custom lens requires most fields to be entered and checked manually, leaving 3 hours of standard prescription reuse and 2 net; no source capture or release saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Retrieve prior records or verify optical prescriptions

steps.what: Locate the customer's prior optical record and prescription source
Prepare a necessary prescription-verification request to the examining practitioner
Check the final verification request, permission and practitioner destination
outputs: final checked verification request and destination

steps.what: Send the checked verification request to the examining practitioner
inputs: final checked verification request and destination

steps.what: Verify the returned prescription against identity, dates and ambiguous values
Enter the verified prescription source and findings in the optical record

tasks.design: Configure native customer-record search in the optical-practice and secure clinical-messaging category {OTHER} to avoid repeated index navigation. Preserve identity checks, necessary request writing, a separate approved request send, clinical verification and the original record entry.
tasks.previous_blocker: Prior records may be difficult to locate and ambiguous prescriptions need the actual examiner.
tasks.enabler_now: Native search shortcuts can reduce index navigation without interpreting clinical values.
tasks.still_hard: Matching the correct customer and resolving uncertain prescription content.
tasks.human_edge: Know when a value needs direct practitioner confirmation.
tasks.altitude: Less record navigation; unchanged prescription verification duty.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native record search can shorten retrieval but cannot replace professional prescription verification.

assumptions: This graph models the external-verification branch. A complete existing-record-only case omits the request/response sequence and must be reweighted, not charged invented sends. Shares are provisional.

Customer identity and sharing permission are established by the optician within s1-s3; the index contains existing customer identifiers and prescription-source references. Missing records are pursued manually in retained steps; no free external record feed is assumed.
Only repeated index navigation, 10% of s1, is removed by native search. Request composition, response interpretation, original verified entry and ordinary ungated save remain fully retained.

s3 binds completed request, permitted information and exact examiner destination before s4; edits void approval. Practitioner response labour is external and earns no focal saving; waiting time is not labour.
research_questions: Does native search remove navigation while preserving identity and source checks?

already_counted.description: Search fallback, identity, request checks and clinical verification remain.

incremental.description: Optician checks record-search links and permissions after changes.

approvals.approved_version: s3 final verification request, permitted information and exact examining-practitioner destination; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100; 20*0.10=2 navigation hours removed less 0.4 upkeep gives 1.6 net. Cautious case: an archived paper prescription needs manual retrieval, leaving 0.5 hours of existing-index navigation removed and 0.1 net; clinical verification and entry remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

Check product availability, current price and applicable terms
Enter chosen products, quantities and customer details in the sale
Check the final basket, customer agreement and payment amount
outputs: final agreed optical sale and payment amount

steps.what: Commit the agreed optical sale in the checkout system
inputs: final agreed optical sale and payment amount

steps.what: Take payment for the committed sale
inputs: final agreed optical sale and payment amount

inputs: final agreed optical sale and payment amount

tasks.design: Configure a native product-context stock/price view in the optical retail checkout category {OTHER} to avoid repeated tab navigation. Retain consultation, sale entry, agreement checks, commercial commitment, payment and handover; existing automatic checkout totals earn no saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Product availability and terms may require switching among existing screens.
tasks.enabler_now: A native product view can expose those source records together.
tasks.still_hard: Suitable products, informed customer agreement and prescription-related restrictions.
tasks.human_edge: Match the customer's needs and explain costs clearly.
tasks.altitude: Small screen-navigation relief; unchanged selling responsibility.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native retail product views can shorten stock/price navigation, while transaction and payment runtime may already be automatic.

assumptions: Boundary is an over-the-counter optical goods sale. Custom laboratory fabrication uses task 4203 rather than being counted again here. Shares are provisional.

Stock staff and pricing staff maintain product identifier, availability, price, tax and terms. The optician checks them in s2; stale/missing values require manual clarification there. Customer selection and details are actually entered in s3, not assumed free.

Test native combined stock/price view first. Only repeated tab navigation, 8% of s2, is removed. Sale entry and its ordinary ungated draft save remain fully retained; the real commercial commit has its actual 1% share and no saving.

s4 checks the final basket, customer agreement, exact amount and customer before separate commit s5, payment s6 and goods/receipt issue s7. Any change voids all corresponding approvals. Payment must succeed before handover; existing automatic total and receipt runtime are not labour.
research_questions: Can a native product view remove tab switching while keeping source currency checks?

already_counted.description: Availability and terms checking remain in s2; transaction and payment work remain fully retained.

incremental.description: Optician checks stock/price view links after catalogue changes.

approvals.approved_version: s4 final customer-agreed basket, terms, customer and payment amount; edits void approval
s4 exact agreed customer sale and payment amount, matching committed sale s5; edits void approval
s4 exact agreed goods, customer and receipt details, conditional on matching successful payment s6; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100; 15*0.08=1.2 navigation hours removed less 0.3 upkeep gives 0.9 net. Cautious case: unusual goods need manual stock confirmation, leaving 0.4 hours of known-product tab switching removed and 0.1 net; no native checkout-runtime saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Native optical forms and views reduce repeated entry and navigation; dispensing, instruction, verification and customer transactions remain accountable human work.
role.ambitious_version: No autonomous optical dispensing or additional commercial authority is proposed.
